codex_contract.preserved_semantics: Spawn N parallel candidates at the same task, pick a base, graft the strongest parts of the losers into it. Use for /arena, 'arena this', 'throw it in the arena', or when one attempt at a non-trivial artifact would lock in the wrong shape.

native_mapping.fallback: An unavailable candidate or judge is recorded as missing/partial, not a fabricated winner or full arena result.
native_mapping.availability: bounded_native_n2_candidates_cross_judge_graft_verify_observed; Work cloud, exact upstream Cursor roles, and automatic trigger remain unproven

permission_gates: Do not use Work cloud or hidden cloud workers without explicit authorization; this observed path used native local subagents.
Launch candidates with the same contract into separate writable paths, then read every artifact before judging.
An unavailable candidate or judge is recorded as missing/partial, not a fabricated winner.
Respect the current task scope, selected model/effort, repository ownership, and explicit approval requirements.

behavioral_proof.positive: Native bounded proof: N=2 disjoint general-worker candidates were written and read end to end; an independent reviewer cross-judge scored 19/24 versus 17/24, selected Candidate 1, named Candidate 2 grafts/rejections, and the coordinator applied the grafts. A failed hypothesis triggered a planner redesign, and the synthesized disposable contract passed create/retry-unchanged/changed-replace/malformed-conflict/source-conflict/reset checks. This is fixture-only workflow proof.
behavioral_proof.missing_tool_or_input: If a candidate or judge is unavailable, record the exact dropout and mark the aggregate partial; one fallback candidate is not an arena and no winner is fabricated.
behavioral_proof.error: Malformed input, failed candidate, failed judge, or synthesis verification failure is reported with its slice and evidence; the aggregate does not claim full coverage or widen scope.

upstream_readme.note: Verified in the pinned upstream clone; the README is referenced for provenance and is not vendored in this skills-only snapshot.

security_review.decision: Keep the source finding and provenance; do not dismiss it because the adapter adds a warning.

codex_note:
## Codex runtime mapping

Use native Codex subagents and isolated paths for parallel candidates, not Cursor `Task`, Work cloud, or `~/.cursor/rules`. In the observed native path, candidates used `multi_agent_v1__spawn_agent` with `agent_type=general-worker` and the cross-judge used `agent_type=reviewer`; the exact upstream Cursor roles and automatic trigger are not proven. Keep the same rubric, full-candidate read, cross-judge, base selection, named graft, redesign-on-failure, and verification phases. Follow the standing model router and task authority; record invocation metadata separately from worker self-report.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: Spawn N parallel candidates at the same task, pick a base, graft the strongest parts of the losers into it. Use for /arena, 'arena this', 'throw it in the arena', or when one attempt at a non-trivial artifact would lock in the wrong shape.
proof: Pinned source hash and deterministic build are static provenance. A disposable native N=2 run produced separate candidate artifacts, a reviewer cross-judge score and base/graft decision, a planner redesign after a failed hypothesis, and a passing synthesized contract check. Exact agent types and requested model/effort metadata are recorded in the companion report; completion messages are self-reports. Work cloud, automatic trigger, production artifact behavior, and cross-host parity remain unproven.
reason: Port Cursor-only delegation, model and context storage to native Codex while retaining the upstream workflow and evidence contract.

replacements.before: Use `arena runners` from `~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc` when present. Otherwise default to one each on `claude-fable-5-1-thinking-max`, `gpt-5.6-sol-max`, `grok-4.6-fast-xhigh`, `claude-opus-5-thinking-xhigh`.
replacements.after: Choose available native Codex runners under the standing `model-capability-router` policy and the operator’s explicit selection. Use structurally distinct prompts or models when comparison needs diversity; record the actual runners.

replacements.before: Spawn all N subagents in one message with `run_in_background: true`, each with the task, the path to the shared grounding, its own output path, and instructions to produce both the artifact and a short rationale.
replacements.after: Launch N independent Codex subagents in parallel when authorized, each with the same task contract, the shared grounding path, its own isolated output path, and a short rationale. Keep one writer per path and wait for each artifact before judging.

replacements.before: choose one model from the `arena cross-judge pool` in `~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc` when present. Otherwise use `claude-fable-5-1-thinking-max`, `gpt-5.6-sol-max`, `grok-4.6-fast-xhigh`, `claude-opus-5-thinking-xhigh`. Prefer a different model family from the parent's. Spawn one readonly judge subagent on that model.
replacements.after: choose an available native Codex judge under the standing `model-capability-router` policy, preferably with an independent model perspective when available. Spawn one read-only judge subagent after candidate writes finish, or have the coordinator perform an explicit independent judgment if no authorized judge is available.
